candidates.description: This vector activates strongly for the Thai consonant 'ม' (Mo Ma) and words or tokens containing it, alongside its uppercase and lowercase English counterparts.
This vector represents Thai language text processing fragments, specifically common suffixes and word endings associated with nominalization and grammatical markers.
This vector activates for the Thai preposition "ใน" (meaning "in" or "within") as well as common words, prefixes, and subword tokens containing or following it.
This feature vector activates strongly on the Thai letter 'ส' (So Suea) and words containing it.
This feature vector activates strongly on the Thai consonant 'ว' (wo waen) and its combinations with various vowels, tone marks, and preceding characters.
This vector represents the letter 'D' or common abbreviations, titles, and linguistic variations associated with it.
This feature vector activates on tokens related to the natural world, biological sciences, and foundational academic subjects.
This vector represents named entity recognition tags and linguistic entity categories across various languages.
This vector is related to common conjunctions, prepositions, and grammatical particles in English and Thai.
This vector activates on Polish-related linguistic subwords and distinct Polish geographic and national terms.
